name: count-badge
title: Count Badge
description: A count on the corner of an icon that springs in, jumps as it rises, rolls its number and shrinks away at zero.

perf.budget: One small view and three shared values; it animates only when the count changes. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: The number changes in place without the jump; the badge still appears and disappears.
a11y.screenReader: The badge reads its label, such as "3 unread"; it is hidden at zero.
a11y.touchTarget: Not interactive; the element under it keeps its own target.
